Postman collection for testing Question Set Full CRUD (Module 1, Step 4) and Sessions & Joining (Module 2).

Seeded accounts used:
- host: school_id 2099-0001 (Host Account, HOST role)
- otherHost: school_id 2099-0003 (Second Host, HOST role)
- player: school_id 2099-1001 (Alice Player, PLAYER role)

Collection variables:
- baseUrl: http://localhost:3001/api/v1
- host, otherHost, player: school_id values for X-Demo-User header
- setId: captured from the create question-set response, reused across subsequent cases
- sessionCode: captured from the create session response, reused across session cases
- playerId, playerScore: captured from the first join, reused to verify rejoin
